<entry id="O01313">
<head-word>סָפַג</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of סְפוֹג) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to swallow, absorb</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to VII, 3 מה חטה זו סוֹפֶגֶת … סוֹפְגִין וכ' as the wheat (flour) absorbs (water), so Israel absorbs &c. Ab. V, 15, v. סְפוֹג; a. e.—Trnsf. (cmp. לָקָה, בְּלַע) 
<italic>to receive lashes, be punished</italic>. Tem. I, 1, a. fr. סוֹפֵג את הארבעים receives forty (thirty-nine) lashes. Naz. IV, 3 אם אינה סופגת … תִּסְפּוֹג וכ' if she cannot receive the Biblical punishment, let her receive the punishment for rebellion; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to use a</italic> סְפוֹג, 
<italic>to wipe, dry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XXII, 1 לא יִסְפּוֹג (Ar. יְסַפֵּג 
<italic>Pi.</italic>) he must not put down a sponge (to absorb the spilt wine). Zeb. VI, 5 סְפָגוֹ במלח he dried the dripping head of the sacrifice by rubbing salt on it. Tosef. ib. VII, 10 מלח ולא ס' ס' וכ' if he put salt on but did not dry it, or if he dried it without putting salt on; a. e.—Sabb. 145
<sup>a</sup> לסוֹפְגָן במלח Ar. (ed. לסופתן, v. סָפַת).—[Tosef. Zab. I, 9 וסופג, read: וסִפּוּג.—Yalk. Deut. 840 סופגין, read: סופנין, v. סָפַן.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סִיפֵּג</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same; v. supra, a. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְפִּיג</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to wipe, dry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 7
<sup>b</sup> וטבל ולא מַסְפִּיג (Rashi: מְסַפֵּג 
<italic>Pi.</italic>) he must dip (Lev. IV, 6) but not wipe, i.e. there must be blood enough in the vessel to dip the finger into it; Yalk. Lev. 469; Zeb. 93
<sup>b</sup> מְסַפֵּג. Num. R. s. 17 נטלו והִסְפִּיגוֹ he took it (the flayed ram) and wiped it (with salt, v. supra); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to receive drippings, collect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 94 כשרף הזה … עד שמַסְפִּיגִין אותו like resin which scarcely begins to ooze out, when arrangements are made to collect it; Tanḥ. B’midb. 16 (not השבט); ed. Bub. ib. 19; Yalk. Ezra 1067.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְתַּפֵּג, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִסְתַּפֵּג</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be wiped off, dried</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. l. c. כאילו יצחק מִסְתַּפֵּג לפניך as if Isaac’s blood had been wiped off. Sabb. XXII, 5 הריחץ … ונ' if one bathed … and dried himself &c. Ib. מִסְתַּפְּגִין וכ' wipe themselves with one sheet. Yoma III, 4. Tosef. Zab. I, 9 כדי … ויִסְתַּפֵּג time enough for a person to bathe, come up and dry himself; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O01315">
<head-word>סָפַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to strike, beat;</italic> cmp. Lat. plango,] 
<italic>to lament, mourn</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 57
<sup>a</sup> סִיפְדוּ לזה mourn for this man. Snh. 47
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. אל תִּסְפְּדוּנִי וכ' do not hold services for me in the towns; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְפִּיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to arrange funeral</italic> or 
<italic>memorial services for; to lament, eulogise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. I, 5 ולא יַסְפִּידֶנּוּ קידם וכ' and must not engage a 
<italic>safdan</italic> (eulogist) for him thirty days before a festival. Meg. 28
<sup>b</sup> אין מַסְפִּידִין בהן וכ' no funeral services for an individual must be held in them (the synagogues); ומספידין … רבים but you may use them for funeral services in cases of public mourning (for a distinguished person). Treat. S’maḥ. III, 4 מספידין לעניים וכ' mourning services are held for children of poor men at the age of three, for those of rich men at the age of four years. M. Kat. 21
<sup>b</sup> והִסְפִּידוּם הספד גדול and they arranged a great lamentation over them (the sons of R. ‘Aḳiba); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִסְפַּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be mourned for, be eulogised</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 47
<sup>a</sup> מת לא נ' וכ' a dead not mourned for and not buried. Yeb. 78
<sup>b</sup> שלא נ' כהלכה no appropriate lamentations were held over his remains; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> אַכְפְּדָהּ לכלתיה וכ' held funeral services for his daughter-in-law in the synagogue; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to beat the hip in mourning</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to XII, 7 הוה מַסְפִּיד בחדא ידא וכ' made the motion of mourning with one hand and of praising (Nebuchadnezzar) with the other; Yalk Ez. 364 הוון … ומַסְפִּידִין וכ'.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O01323">
<head-word>סְפוֹג</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (ספג, cmp. ספח) 
<italic>a porous luxuriant growth, mushroom; sponge, any sponge-like material; wiper</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> (in Chald. dict.) ההן דגזז ס' וכ' he who cuts mushrooms etc. (on the Sabbath) is guilty of the acts of harvesting and of planting (the cutting being the means of advancing the growth). B. Kam. 115
<sup>b</sup>; Succ. 50
<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Mal. 587 ארס … דומה לס' וכ' the venom of the serpent (on top of liquids) resembles a fungus (Ar.: a veil-like growth on the head of a certain sea-fish) and remains floating &c.; (Y. Ter. VII, 45
<sup>d</sup> bot. עומד כסבכה, v. סְבָכָה). Kel. IX, 4 ס' שבלע וכ' a mushroom which has absorbed unclean liquids, though it is dry on the outside etc. Sabb. XXI, 3 ס' אם יש לו עור וכ' a sponge (used for sucking up liquids), if it has leather handles etc. Tosef. ib. V (VI), 3 ס' שע''ג המכה an absorbent substance (wool) put on a wound. Y. ib. XVII, 15
<sup>c</sup> top ונתן עליה ס' יבש and he put on it a dry sucker (compress); Lev. R. s. 15; Lam. R. to IV, 20; a. fr.—Ab. V, 15 ס' שהוא סופג וכ' (a scholar indiscriminately cramming his mind is called) a sponge, because he absorbs every thing.—
<plural-form>Pl. סְפוֹגִים, סְפוֹגִין</plural-form>. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15
<sup>d</sup> top רצו לחתוך ס' (divers) wanted to cut sponges. Sabb. 129
<sup>b</sup> ס' של צמר tufts of wool; (Tosef. ib. XV (XVI), 3 כסות). Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> הביאו ס' של צמד וכ' they took tufts of wool, soaked them with water, and put them onhis heart; a. e.—[Σπόγγος, σφόγγος seems to be of Semitic origin.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>סָפַח</head-word>
<senses>

<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to grow, swell, be added to</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סִפֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סִיפֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>supply</italic>, 
<italic>furnish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. s. 6 אם מְסַפֵּק לנו צרכנו וכ' (ed. Weiss מַסְפִּיק, 
<italic>Hif.</italic>) if he supplies our wants, we shall serve him &c. B. Mets. IX, 1 (103
<sup>b</sup>) שניהם מְסַפְּקִין את הקנים the two together have to furnish the needed poles. Sot. 11
<sup>b</sup> היו מְסַפְּקוֹת להם מים ומזון they supplied them with water and food; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII לספק לו, v. סְפִיקוּלָא I.]—V. סִיפּוּק II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְפִּיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to distribute, supply</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 4 (ref. to יספוק, Job XXXIV, 37) אתה מַסְפִּיק בנינו וכ' thou distributest thy sins among us, i.e. we have to suffer for thy sins; Yalk. Job 920 משתיק (corr. acc.; Var. משְׂפִּיק). Mekh. l. c., v. supra; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with ביד) 
<italic>to give sufficient time</italic> or 
<italic>power; to allow</italic> an opportunity.</definition>
<notes> Ab. V, 18 אין מַסְפִּיקִין בידו וכ' no time (or opportunity) will be given him to do repentance; Yoma 87
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. V (IV), 11. Ib. 10 אין מספיקין בידו וכ' he will be given no opportunity (temptation) to sin; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to have sufficient time, power</italic> &c.; 
<italic>to succeed, finish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 21
<sup>a</sup> לא הִסְפַּקְתִּי לפרוק וכ' I had not yet finished unloading when &c. Y. Ber. IX, 14
<sup>b</sup> bot. לא ה' לומר עד וכ' he had not yet finished saying Sh’m‘a, when he expired; a. fr.—[Ib. 14
<sup>a</sup> מספיק למדינה, v. סָפַח.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hitpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְתַּפֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִסְתַּפֵּק </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be supplied, to supply one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 8
<sup>a</sup> במִסְתַּפֵּק when it is a store-room from which supplies are taken for the table; ib.
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44
<sup>d</sup> bot. אבותיכם היו מִסְתַּפְּקִין משלנו וכ' (not בשלנו) your fathers used to buy supplies (of wine) of our fathers, why do you not buy of us? Y. Dem. III, 23
<sup>c</sup>, a. e. מִסְתַּפֶּקֶת, v. סִידְקִי. Erub. 88
<sup>a</sup> אדם עשוי להִסְתַּפֵּק סאתים וכ' a person usually consumes two S’ah of water a day (from the supply in the cistern &c.); a. fr.—Der. Er. ch. VII ונִסְתַּפְּקוּ they ate and were amply supplied (enjoyed their meal).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. סָפֵק) 
<italic>to be doubtful</italic> Y. Yeb. XI, end, 12
<sup>b</sup> נ' לו he was in doubt.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<italic>doubt</italic>, opp. וַדַּאי.</definition>
<notes> Ker. IV, 1 ס' אכל ס' לא אכל if there is a doubt whether or not he has eaten forbidden fat; ס' יש בו וכ' if there is a doubt whether it was the legally required quantity. B. Bath. 10
<sup>a</sup> ס' מקבלין … ס' אין וכ' it is uncertain whether it will be accepted from him or not. Ab. Zar. 41
<sup>a</sup> הוי ס' וכ', v. וַדַּאי. Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>b</sup> bot. סְפֵיקוֹ, סְפֵיקָהּ where there is a doubt about it, v. וַדַּאי. Ib. מאי ס' וש שם what is the doubt there? i. fr. what difference does it make in practice?—Yeb. 37
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ממון המוטל בס', v. מָמוֹן. Ker. VI, 3 (25
<sup>a</sup>) המתן עד שתכנס לס' (Var. in Talm. ed. לבית הס') wait until you arrive at a condition of doubt, i.e. until you are in doubt as to having committed a sin requiring a sacrifice. Ib. 2 כִּפְּרָה סְפֵיקָהּ וכ' the heifer has atoned for the doubt for which it has been put to death, and is gone (i.e. at the time of its being thrown down the murderer was unknown); ib. 25
<sup>a</sup> עדיין לא כיפרה סְפֵיקָתָהּ it had not yet atoned for the doubt for which it was to be put to death; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. סְפֵיקוֹת, סְפֵק'</plural-form> (
<italic>fem</italic>.). Kidd. IV, 3 ואלו הן הס' and these are the cases of uncertain parentage. B. Mets. 83
<sup>b</sup> ס' שלכם cases in which you act on doubts (mere suspicion), v. וַדָּאָה. Y. Keth. I, beg. 24
<sup>d</sup> שתי ס' a double doubt, v. next w.; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>dilemma</italic>, 
<italic>difficulty</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to VII, 8 למה באו ישראל בס' וכ' why did the Israelites get into trouble in the days of Haman?</notes></sense></senses></entry>
